about.title: Founded by leaders. Focused on what works.
about.lead: Presented by YASA Laser, Innovate is a conference built by Canadian R&D and clinical leaders who prioritize outcomes over hype.
about.body: Innovate is founded by Dr. Arjang Yazdani, FRCSC, and Nadine Sabino, RN — pioneers in aesthetic laser medicine, provider training, and clinical innovation across Canada. Their work spans advanced energy-based treatments, surgical and non-surgical care, and national education for aesthetic teams.
highlights: Showcase the latest advancements and innovations shaping the future of medical aesthetics.
Provide a platform for industry leaders to introduce new technologies and products launching in 2027
Encourage informed debate and critical evaluation of emerging trends, evolving techniques, and approaches that are challenging conventional thinking in aesthetic medicine.
about.imageAlt: Nadine Sabino and Dr. Arjang Yazdani beside a Sciton Joule laser system at Yazdani Aesthetics
